translations.web: The mountains shall bring prosperity to the people. The hills bring the fruit of righteousness.
translations.bsb: May the mountains bring peace to the people, and the hills bring righteousness.
translations.kjv: The mountains shall bring peace to the people, and the little hills, by righteousness.
translations.asv: The mountains shall bring peace to the people, And the hills, in righteousness.
